scope: H6: reject per-command Git alias configurations that conceal restricted Git commands from delivery and source-edit policy.

libraries.verified: H6: official git(1) docs confirm -c name=value passes command-scoped config, and --config-env=name=envvar likewise sets command configuration from an environment variable. Official git-config docs confirm alias.* defines Git command aliases (including commit, push, reset aliases). These forms must be refused by talvora_git_run before policy gates.
